g.text: SPI mode 3 + per-word CRC — the master engine, as the code has it
the chain is POSITIONAL: each branch tests the state one
lower than the branch above, so a missing state does not
become unreachable, it SHIFTS every state above it
bit_loop — ONE mode-3 cell, full duplex
entered and left with SCLK HIGH
dmem[8] out, dmem[10] count, dmem[11] acc, dmem[12] return state
SCL high: the slave captures MOSI
IN A,PIN / AND A,8 reads MISO
fold_byte — CRC-8 in an ISA with no XOR
V = 0x80 test, P = poly 0x07 if set
dmem[6] response CRCs that CHECKED OUT
dmem[7] the last word's transmitted CRC-8
The comparison is on the firmware's own
side of the wire: recompute CRC-8(RESP)
in software and compare with the byte
that came back. A program that never
reports 3 of 3 — so the TB corrupts one
response CRC on purpose and demands 2.
